competences.description: Attacks the enemy with an Energy ball. The attack has a 75% chance of increasing the enemy's chance to land a Glancing Hit for 2 turns.

effets.description: The chance of landing a glancing hit will be increased by 50%. Glancing Hits will decrease the damage by 30% and if the attacker has attribute disadvantage, damage will be decreased additionally by 16%.

competences.description: Attacks the enemy with the flames of punishment to remove the target's one beneficial effect with an 80% chance and inflicts Continuous Damage for 3 turns with a 100% chance.

effets.description: Removes one or more beneficial effects from target monster(s)
The target's HP will be damaged by 5% of the MAX HP whenever the target's turn returns. (Ignores Defense)

competences.description: Revives a dead ally and fills up the ally's HP by 30%. Revives another ally with a 30% chance. All skills of the revived allies are ready to be used.

effets.description: Reduces cool down counter of skills by 1 or more
